subject.title: Feature: configurable dateFormat (UK/US/ISO) for envelope and system-event date display

question: Should OpenClaw accept a new `agents.defaults.dateFormat` config field for model-visible envelope and system-event date order, and if so which enum and surfaces are in scope?
rationale: The implementation path is bounded, but repository policy sets a high bar for new config/default surfaces and prior timestamp-display discussion shows ISO formatting was an intentional maintainer concern.

options.title: Approve narrow dateFormat
options.body: Accept a small enum for human-readable envelope and system-event display only, leaving filenames and machine-readable timestamps ISO.

options.title: Keep ISO-only
options.body: Reject the config expansion and document that prompt-facing timestamps intentionally remain unambiguous and sortable ISO order.

options.title: Fold into broader time UX
options.body: Keep this open until related timezone/date display requests are resolved under one configuration design.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow dateFormat
recommendation.body: Accept a small enum for human-readable envelope and system-event display only, leaving filenames and machine-readable timestamps ISO.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the clearest recent product-direction signal for ISO timestamp display changes and relevant adjacent source history.
